subject: UI interaction file upload v file restore from RData

messages.author: ff699f651734499a
messages.subject: UI interaction file upload v file restore from RData
parts:
Hi,

I am saving my shiny application state so later it can be restored and taken from that point forward. I have it working. The part I am having an issue with is the restore of the data. The application is data driven. So the first thing thew user does in the ui is upload a file. This is the code.

fileInput("dta", "Select dataset:", 
                accept = c( ".xls", ".xlsx")
      ),


The excel file has multiple sheets that are stored into variables and saved into an RData file. The value of dta is also saved.

The data loads from the RData files when the environment restores. I don't want the application to ask the user to upload a file and just start where they left off. I can't seem to get this to work with both a upload for a new project or a restore for an existing project in the same code..

I tried the following.

conditionalPanel(
        condition= "input.dta == NULL",
        fileInput("dta", "Select dataset:", 
                  accept = c( ".xls", ".xlsx")
        )),

I am having issues with setting input.dta when I restore.


The code that process the XL files are here:

 raworg <- reactive({
    infile <- input$dta
    if (is.null(infile))
    {
      # User has not uploaded a file yet
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    else{
      
      withProgress(message="Processing File Data", value=0, {
      
        nsteps <- 4
        
        incProgress(1/nsteps, detail = paste("Copying file data"))
        
        excelFile <- file.path( tempdir(), infile$name )
        file.copy( infile$datapath, excelFile)
        
        incProgress(1/nsteps, detail = paste("Extracting worksheet names"))
        
        sheet_names <- excel_sheets(excelFile)
        
        incProgress(1/nsteps, detail = paste("Extracting worksheets"))
        
        dat <- lapply(sheet_names,
                      function(x) {
                        res <- read_excel(excelFile, sheet = x)
                        res <- cbind(res, x, match(x, sheet_names))
                        return(res)
                      }
        )
        
        incProgress(1/nsteps, detail = paste("Combining worksheets"))
        
        dat <- do.call(rbind, dat)
        UUO <- dat[, c(2, 3, 15, ncol(dat)-1, ncol(dat))]
      })
      
      colnames(UUO) <- c("sample_name", "category", "resp", "sheetname", "depth")
      
      return(list(UUO=UUO,dat=dat))
    }
  })
